parameters.content:
Salesforce forecast to Ziffr: values

1. Fill in the Settings node: your Ziffr address and your Salesforce address, your time zone and which Metric each figure is for.
2. Add the credentials: Salesforce OAuth2 on the read nodes, and a Header Auth credential named "Ziffr Feed Key" (name Authorization, value Bearer <your Feed Key>) on Send to Ziffr. Make the key in Ziffr under Settings, Feeds, and add the Feed under Who submits on each Metric.
3. Press Execute workflow once to try it, then activate it: it runs every Monday at 12, for the week that has just ended (UTC).

Opportunity totals, read only: closed this quarter and pipeline value, and if you like commit and best case, for the week that has just ended, for the team and per salesperson.

Salespeople with Metrics of their own go in the node "Owners". Pipeline, commit and best case are what the CRM says at the moment of the run and are sent only on a Monday or Tuesday.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ "SELECT OwnerId, SUM(Amount) amountSum, COUNT(Id) dealCount, COUNT(Amount) pricedCount FROM Opportunity WHERE IsWon = true" + " AND CloseDate >= " + $('Week').first().json.quarterFirst + " AND CloseDate <= " + $('Week').first().json.wonLast + " GROUP BY OwnerId" }}

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: ={{ "SELECT OwnerId, ForecastCategory, SUM(Amount) amountSum, COUNT(Id) dealCount, COUNT(Amount) pricedCount FROM Opportunity WHERE IsClosed = false" + " AND CloseDate >= " + $('Week').first().json.quarterFirst + " AND CloseDate <= " + $('Week').first().json.quarterLast + " GROUP BY OwnerId, ForecastCategory" }}
